transcript.text: my oven fan keeps going after ive turned the oven off, been about 20 mins now. is it broken??

It is very likely not broken. Most ovens have a 'cooling fan' that automatically stays on for 10–30 minutes after you switch off to cool down the controls and prevent the surrounding cabinets from getting too hot. To be sure this is normal, please check:
1. Is the noise coming from inside the oven cavity (the cooking fan) or from the fascia/controls area at the top?
2. Does it eventually stop once the oven feels cool to touch? If it's a quiet hum from the controls and it stops after cooling down, that is normal behaviour. If it's the main cooking fan running when it shouldn't be, or if the controls are getting very hot, let me know.

its a steady soft whirr and the warm air is coming out of the slot above the door. it does stop eventually, usually after 20-30 mins. oven isnt getting very hot on the controls as far as i can tell, door and top are still warm though

That sounds exactly like the cooling fan doing its job. Since it stops after 20–30 minutes and the controls aren't getting hot, there is no fault here. You can leave it to run until it switches off by itself.

candidates: Cooling fan motor or thermostat fault (medium)
